items.stem: Why is verifying a transition state with a vibrational-frequency calculation important?

options.text: A true transition state has exactly one imaginary frequency along the reaction coordinate
options.rationale: Correct: one imaginary frequency confirms a first-order saddle point.

options.text: It confirms the structure is an energy minimum
options.rationale: A minimum has no imaginary frequencies, unlike a transition state.

options.text: Frequencies are irrelevant to transition states
options.rationale: The imaginary mode is the defining feature of a transition state.

options.text: It proves the basis set is complete
options.rationale: Frequency analysis checks the stationary point, not basis completeness.

items.explanation: Correct: one imaginary frequency confirms a first-order saddle point.

items.stem: Which TWO trade-offs must be weighed when choosing a level of theory? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: higher-level methods are generally more accurate.

options.text: Computational cost and system size feasibility
options.rationale: Correct: cost scales steeply and limits tractable system size.

options.text: The colour of the visualisation software
options.rationale: Rendering choices do not affect the method's validity.

options.text: The alphabetical order of element symbols
options.rationale: That is irrelevant to the level of theory.

items.explanation: Correct: higher-level methods are generally more accurate.

items.stem: What is the key limitation of a machine-learning interatomic potential?

options.text: It is reliable only for configurations represented in its training data
options.rationale: Correct: ML potentials extrapolate poorly beyond training coverage.

options.text: It can replace experiments entirely with no checks
options.rationale: Validation against reference data is still required.

options.text: It works equally well for any chemistry without training
options.rationale: Performance depends on relevant training data.

options.text: It has no computational cost advantage
options.rationale: A major motivation is lower cost than high-level methods.

items.explanation: Correct: ML potentials extrapolate poorly beyond training coverage.
